(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE P. B. BAJANTHRI)
9 08-11-2023 Gist of the matter is that appellant-Gopal Prasad Sah married respondent-Premlata Jaiswal and they married on 03.12.1998 and Respondent gave birth to a girl baby on 28.03.2000.
Further, wife Premlata Jaiswal who is stated to have left the matrimonial home on 28.10.2001.
She has filed criminal case for the offences under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and it is pending consideration.
The appellant had filed petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for restitution of conjugal rights and it was dismissed on 30.07.2012.

Respondent-Premlata Jaiswal had filed Maintenance Petition which was numbered as 63 (M) of 2004 it Patna High Court MA No.136 of 2022(9) dt.08-11-2023 was disposed on 30.09.2019 while awarding maintenance of Rs. 6,000/-
and 1,000/- to the wife and the daughter respectively alongwith cost of Rs. 10,000/-.
The appellant is complying the directions in the maintenance petition.
In the meanwhile, appellant has filed Divorce Suit No. 4 of 2014 under the territorial jurisdiction of Jharkhand.

Thereafter, Divorce Suit No. 4 of 2014 was transferred to State of Bihar and it was re- numbered as Matrimonial (Divorce)
Case No. 346 of 2015 on the file of the Principal Judge, Sahibganj, Family Court, it was ex parte order disposed on merit.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that respondent-Premlata Jaiswal may not be interested in participating in the Matrimonial Case, since she has remained absent before the Family Court and so also before this Court despite service of notice.
Therefore, in order to give an opportunity to the respective parties, re-list this matter on 20.12.2023.
The respective parties are hereby directed to appear before mediation and conciliation center of this Court on 29.11.2023.

3. It is made clear that if there is no amicable settlement before the Mediation and Conciliation Center before the next date of hearing the matter would be decided with the Patna High Court MA No.136 of 2022(9) dt.08-11-2023 available records on merit.

(P. B. Bajanthri, J) ( Ramesh Chand Malviya, J) saurabhkr/-
